questions.q: The PageRank algorithm used by the Google search engine was developed by:
questions.exp: PageRank was devised by Larry Page and Sergey Brin at Stanford.

questions.exp: justify-content works on the main axis, which is horizontal for row direction.

questions.q: Which attribute makes a hyperlink open the target page in a new browser tab?

questions.exp: <fieldset> groups controls; <legend> supplies its caption.

questions.exp: <canvas> is the HTML5 drawing surface controlled through the Canvas API.

questions.q: In a search engine, which component follows hyperlinks and fetches web pages so that they can be indexed?
questions.exp: A crawler (spider/bot) discovers and downloads pages for the indexer.

questions.q: According to the same-origin policy, two URLs have the same origin if they share the same:
questions.exp: Origin is defined as the combination of protocol (scheme), host name and port.

questions.q: Which protocol is commonly used to upload website files to a hosting server, using TCP port 21 for control?
questions.exp: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) uses port 21 for its control connection.

questions.q: In a three-tier web application architecture, the web browser belongs to the:
questions.exp: The browser displays the user interface, which is the presentation tier.

questions.q: Which organisation develops and maintains the CSS specifications?
questions.exp: The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) publishes the CSS standards; IETF handles HTTP RFCs.

questions.q: Which HTML5 attribute prefix allows custom data to be stored on any element?
questions.exp: data-* attributes (e.g. data-id) hold custom data accessible through the dataset property.

questions.q: Which DOM method adds a new node as the last child of a parent node?
questions.exp: appendChild() appends a node to the end of the parent's child list.

questions.exp: onmouseover fires when the pointer enters an element.

questions.exp: HEAD returns only the response headers.

questions.q: A group of radio buttons that share the same name attribute allows the user to select:

questions.exp: Radio buttons with the same name are mutually exclusive.

What is the output?

questions.q:
Match the HTTP status codes with their meanings:
P. 301   Q. 403   R. 503
1. Forbidden
2. Service Unavailable
3. Moved Permanently
questions.exp: 301 = Moved Permanently, 403 = Forbidden, 503 = Service Unavailable.

questions.q: The first web browser, written by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, was named:
questions.exp: Berners-Lee's first browser/editor was called WorldWideWeb (later renamed Nexus).

questions.q: What is the specificity (ids-classes-elements) of the selector ul li.active a#link?
questions.exp: One id (#link), one class (.active) and three element names (ul, li, a) give 1-1-3.

questions.q:
Match the CSS properties with their purpose:
P. opacity   Q. z-index   R. overflow

2. Transparency level
3. Handling content that exceeds its box

options: describe the operations, messages and endpoint of the service

each term to the list of documents containing it

questions.exp: XMLHttpRequest is the classic browser object for AJAX calls.

questions.q: In CSS, what does the selector p > span select?

A span immediately following a p
Every span that is a direct child of a p

questions.q: After var li = document.createElement("li"); is executed, the new element:
options: is immediately visible at the end of the page
is automatically added to the first ul
exists in memory but is not in the page until it is inserted, e.g. with appendChild()

questions.q: In the URL http://example.com/page.html#section2, the part "section2" is called the:
questions.exp: The part after '#' is the fragment, which points to a location inside the page.

questions.q: The World Wide Web was proposed and developed at CERN by:
questions.exp: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN in 1989-90.

questions.q: Which technology defines the structure and data types of an XML document and is itself written in XML syntax?
questions.exp: XSD is an XML-based schema language; a DTD uses non-XML syntax.

questions.q: Which CSS pseudo-class styles a link that the user has already visited?
questions.exp: :visited matches links that exist in the browser history.

questions.q:
Statement I: HTTP is a stateless protocol.
Statement II: Cookies can be used by a server to maintain state across HTTP requests.
Which is correct?
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
questions.exp: HTTP does not remember earlier requests; cookies and sessions add state on top of it.

questions.q: A div has box-sizing: border-box; width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 5px. What is its total rendered width?
questions.exp: With border-box the declared width already includes padding and border, so the total is 300px.

questions.q: Which HTTP method is idempotent and is normally used to replace an existing resource completely?
questions.exp: PUT replaces the target resource with the supplied representation; repeating it gives the same result.

questions.q: Which HTTP status code indicates that a new resource has been successfully created, typically in response to a POST request?
questions.exp: 201 Created is returned when a request results in a new resource being created.

questions.q: A server returns HTTP status 401 when:
options: the request lacks valid authentication credentials
the HTTP method is not allowed
questions.exp: 401 Unauthorized means authentication is required or has failed.

questions.q: What is the default port number of the HTTPS protocol?
questions.exp: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default; HTTP uses 80.

questions.exp: getElementById returns null when no matching element exists.

questions.exp: Mosaic (1993) was created at the National Center for Supercomputing Applications by Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina.

questions.q: Which attribute declares a namespace in an XML document?
questions.exp: xmlns (XML namespace) associates element names with a namespace URI.

questions.q: Java servlets are executed by:
options: a servlet (web) container such as Apache Tomcat
questions.exp: A servlet container manages the life cycle of servlets on the server.

options: The request has been sent but nothing received
The request completed successfully and the response is ready
Only the headers have been received
questions.exp: readyState 4 = DONE and status 200 = OK, so the response can be used.

questions.q: In which type of web hosting does a customer rent an entire physical server exclusively for their own use?
questions.exp: Dedicated hosting gives one customer the whole physical machine.

questions.q: The robots.txt file on a website is used to:
options: tell crawlers which parts of the site they may or may not crawl
questions.exp: robots.txt gives crawling instructions to well-behaved web robots.

questions.q: Which element is used in an HTML table to group the header rows of the table?

the viewport width is 600px or less
the output device is a printer

questions.exp: The viewport meta tag tells mobile browsers to match the device width and set initial zoom.

questions.exp: Positions 1, 3, 5 and 7 are odd, so 4 elements are selected.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): An element with display: none is removed from the page layout.
Reason (R): An element with visibility: hidden is also removed from the layout.
Choose the correct option.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

questions.exp: typeof null returns "object"; this is a long-standing quirk of the language.

questions.exp: rowspan makes a cell span the given number of rows; colspan spans columns.

questions.exp: Adjoining vertical margins collapse to the larger of the two, i.e. 30px.

The first element matching the selector

questions.exp: REST maps the delete operation to the DELETE method on the resource URI.

questions.exp: JSON requires double-quoted keys and strings and does not allow trailing commas.

appended to the URL as a query string
